question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**has been witnessed**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The sentence is in the present perfect tense, which is formed with "**has/have + past participle**."
 
• The verb "**witness**" is a transitive verb, meaning it needs an object. In this sentence, the object is "it," which is implied.
 
• "**Has been witnessed**" is the correct form of the verb for the third person singular subject "it."
 
• This form indicates that the witnessing happened at some point in the past and has continued up to the present.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Has witnessed**," is in the active voice and is also in the present perfect tense. However, it is incorrect because the verb needs an object.
 
• "**Is witnessed**," is in the passive voice and is in the present tense. It is not appropriate for this sentence because it suggests that the witnessing is happening right now, rather than in the past.
 
• "**Was witness**," is in the past tense and is incorrect because "witness" is a verb, not a noun.
